lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in a repeating grid-like pattern across the lateral flank. The spots are most densely clustered in the anterior region posterior to the gills and become larger and more widely spaced as they progress posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity are visible, particularly in the central flank region, which intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a coordinate-like grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal edge and lower intensity/shadow on the ventral edge.
